title: Bitwarden
description: Bitwarden's brand palette centres on Bitwarden Blue (#175ddc) and Deep Blue (#0c3276), with Off White (#f3f6f9), True White (#ffffff), True Black (#000000), Light Grey (#d8e2eb), and Medium Grey (#99a7b5), plus Teal Highlight (#2cdde9) and Light Teal Highlight (#a2f4fd), and tertiary Green (#7bf1a8), Yellow (#fdc700), and Red (#ff6550). Hex, RGB, and CMYK values are published on Bitwarden's official brand page.
